name: apple-tv-bilingual-v2
description: Apple TV+ bilingual subtitles Chrome extension v2

scripts.dev: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/popup && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/popup.css && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && esbuild src/content/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/content-script.js --watch & esbuild src/popup/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/popup/index.js --watch & wait
scripts.build: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/popup && esbuild src/content/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/content-script.js && esbuild src/popup/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/popup/index.js && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/popup.css
